Maya (PM): Quick sync — I put together a proposed launch gate for the Optimize toolkit (batching, caching, quant recommendations, eval-triggered alerts). Need alignment on minimal acceptance so we can lock scope for the pilot.
Oliver (ENG): Share the checklist plz.
Maya (PM): Posting the trimmed checklist. High level: pilot-only rollout, 2 pilot customers, p50/p95 latency targets preserved, regression < 2% on key evals, infra autoscale tested.
Maya (PM): ```
Acceptance checklist v0.2:
- Pilot gating: 2 customers onboarded and their smoke tests pass
- Latency: p50 within 10% of baseline, p95 within 25%
- Cost: documented per-token savings estimate for each recommendation
- Quality: eval-suite pass rate >= 98% on critical prompts, no >=5% drop on any critical signal
- Fallbacks: quantization fallback to float path verified; caching fallbacks for cold-starts
- Observability: per-model per-route metrics enabled, alerting for eval regressions
- Runbook: rollback + canary steps written and validated in staging
```
Krishna (ML): The quality threshold looks tight. For some heavy quant profiles we might hit 3-4% delta on niche prompts. Recommend allowing a mediated rollout: start with conservative quant, run eval-monitor for 48h, then expand.
Oliver (ENG): Agreed. Also need to confirm batching changes don't violate real-time SLOs for low-latency routes. Can we make batching adaptive per route?
Maya (PM): Yes — plan is route-level policy: real-time routes get small batch caps, bulk routes get aggressive batch sizes. Documented in the policy table I linked earlier.
Julia (Design): For pilot customers, we should include a short UX check: ensure outputs formatting unchanged after quant/cache. Even small token drift can break structured outputs.
Sam (SRE): On infra: we need a smoke test matrix for autoscale and cache TTL behavior. I'll own creating a CI job that exercises burst traffic + cache churn.
Maya (PM): Nice. Proposed owner map: Oliver -> runtime changes + canary, Krishna -> eval-suite thresholds and monitoring hooks, Sam -> infra tests + CI job, Julia -> output parity checklist, me -> customer onboarding + acceptance signoff.
Oliver (ENG): One more ask — add a gating item for rollback time objective (RTO). For Dedicated customers this must be <=5min for config rollback.
Maya (PM): Added to checklist.
